action_items: Implement secondsToDHMS(total) helper returning { gun, saat, dakika, saniye } all via Math.floor: gun=floor(s/86400); saat=floor((s%86400)/3600); dakika=floor((s%3600)/60); saniye=floor(s%60).
Replace the 3-box live time grid (grid-cols-3) with a 4-box grid-cols-4 rendering GÜN/SAAT/DAKİKA/SANİYE with data-testids sure-gun, sure-saat, sure-dakika, sure-saniye.

In the history table, remove the single 'Süre' and its {formatSureShort(c.sure_saniye)}. Add 4 separate (GÜN, SAAT, DAKİKA, SANİYE) and 4 cells with data-testids hist-gun-{c.id}, hist-saat-{c.id}, hist-dakika-{c.id}, hist-saniye-{c.id} rendering the integer value (no unit suffix).
